# The Mindmaker

> Cohort-based and enterprise advisory helping leaders make nervous AI decisions. Founded by Krish Raja.

## Core offers

- [The AI Decision Cohort](/cohort): $3,500 per seat, 3 weeks, quarterly. For senior leaders with a nervous AI decision to make. 10-15 seats per cohort, mostly async with three 90-minute live sessions.
- [Enterprise](/enterprise): The Signal Session ($15,000, 1 day + 48h delivery). The Revenue Architecture ($60,000-$100,000, 30 days). For companies commercializing AI products.

## Request-only offers

- [The AI Immersion](/immersion): $12,000 flat. Half-day facilitated session for up to 8 senior leaders. Request-only, not featured in primary navigation. For CEO-level sponsors who need their exec team aligned on AI fast. 2-page board-ready summary within 5 business days.

## How I operate

- [The operating system behind Mindmaker](/operator): 14-agent fleet managing a 13-venture portfolio, memory architecture, cost optimization patterns. The operational foundation the commercial advice is built on.

## Try it

- [The Operator's Brief](/signal): Live model prices, weekly classified reads (WATCH / SKIP / CALL / TAKE), and the Nervous Decision Machine embedded in-page. Free, no email required. Tagged as WATCH, SKIP, CALL, or TAKE.

## Thought leadership

- [New Age Leadership](/new-age-leadership): How org charts change when AI agents become teammates. Interactive demonstration of human / hybrid / agent-first / emergent roles, with the role-design decisions leaders will face. Draws on the 14-agent Mindmaker fleet as a live example.

## Positioning

Mindmaker is a barbell: cohort at $3,500/seat for leader decisions, enterprise sprints at $15,000-$100,000 for AI commercialization. No 1:1 sprint product on the public site (inquiry only). No fractional executive roles. No ongoing retainers. No production IT work. Every engagement has a fixed scope and a finish line. The primary conversion goals are cohort seat sales through content and qualified enterprise inbound calls.
